passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Researcher Tomas Herrera studied 30 community gardens in one city.
• He wanted to know whether the gardens increase contact between neighbors.
• He surveyed residents living within 200 meters of each garden.
• Residents near gardens reported knowing more neighbors by name.
stem: The student wants to present the aim of Herrera's study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Herrera's study aimed to find out whether community gardens increase contact between neighbors.
Herrera surveyed residents who lived within 200 meters of 30 community gardens in one city.
Residents living near community gardens reported knowing more of their neighbors by name.
Herrera studied a total of 30 community gardens, all of which were located in the same city, over the course of his project.
steps: "Aim" means the purpose of the study.
The second note states it: whether gardens increase contact between neighbors.
The other choices give the method, the result or the scope, not the aim.
key: Distinguish a study's aim, method and findings.
